Jesus himself spoke of the happiness and blessedness of those who believe in Him. The name Randa serves as a reminder of the happiness and joy that comes from a strong relationship with God and obedience to His teachings. Additionally, the name's root in Greek culture, a culture deeply rooted in philosophy and spirituality, further emphasizes the significance of joy and understanding as essential components of a meaningful spiritual journey. Therefore, the name Randa embodies the happiness found in both a personal relationship with God and a deep understanding of spiritual truths.
